# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 c14 P37](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a showy, handsome girl with a fair complexion and blue eyes. She has long, lovely golden hair worn in braids. During her fatal illness, her cheeks are hectically brilliant, her eyes grow overly bright, and her body becomes very thin.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v2 c1 P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005)_

## Personality

Ruby is bright, merry, coquettish, and prone to laughing frequently. She is deeply interested in fancywork, dresses, parties, and talking about her various beaux. Though often frivolous and shallow, she shows a fearful, vulnerable side when forced to confront her mortality.

_Sources: [v3 c11 P7](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0007), [v3 c14 P2](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0002), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P14](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0014), [v3 c14 P37](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0037)_

## Traits

- Gay and merry  <sub>[v3 c11 P7](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0007), [v3 c14 P2](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0002)</sub>
- Coquettish  <sub>[v3 c11 P7](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0007)</sub>

- Afraid of dying  <sub>[v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching  <sub>[v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>
- Fancywork and embroidery  <sub>[v3 c14 P2](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0002), [v3 c14 P33](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0033)</sub>

## Goals

- To secure the White Sands school teaching position for the fall  <sub>[v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>

## History

Ruby grew up in Avonlea as part of a circle of schoolmates including Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Jane Andrews. As a young girl, she participated in outdoor play, such as dramatizing Tennyson's Elaine on the pond. She later attended Queen's Academy alongside her friends. After entering the teaching profession, she fell ill with a severe attack of congestion during the winter, preventing her from continuing her duties. Despite her declining health from galloping consumption, Ruby remained hopeful, pursuing the White Sands school teaching position and continuing her social life with suitors like Herb Spencer. Eventually, her strength failed and she had to give up teaching. One evening in her garden, she confessed her terrifying awareness of her approaching death to Anne. She passed away quietly in her sleep the following night and was laid to rest in the Avonlea graveyard.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c28 P10](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0010), [v1 c34 P20](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0020), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 c11 P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008), [v3 c14 P2](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0002), [v3 c14 P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007), [v3 c14 P10](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0010), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Attended school at Avonlea alongside Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Jane Andrews  <sub>[v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v3 c11 P7](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0007), [v3 c14 P35](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0035)</sub>
- Attended Queen's Academy in Kingsport  <sub>[v1 c34 P20](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0020)</sub>
- Belonged to a family that tended to make a splurge at events  <sub>[v3 c14 P36](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0036)</sub>

## Quotes

> I don’t mind floating down when there’s two or three of us in the flat and we can sit up. It’s fun then. But to lie down and pretend I was dead—I just couldn’t. I’d die really of fright.  <sub>[v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)</sub>

> I’ll be away Tuesday and Wednesday evenings. There’s a concert at Carmody and a party at White Sands. Herb Spencer’s going to take me. He’s my latest. Be sure to come up tomorrow. I’m dying for a good talk with you. I want to hear all about your doings at Redmond.  <sub>[v3 c11 P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008)</sub>

> How strange the graveyard looks by moonlight! How ghostly!  <sub>[v3 c14 P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007)</sub>

> You know it’s so, don’t you?  <sub>[v3 c14 P9](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0009)</sub>

> Because—because—oh, I’m not afraid but that I’ll go to heaven, Anne. I’m a church member. But—it’ll be all so different. I think—and think—and I get so frightened—and—and—homesick. Heaven must be very beautiful, of course, the Bible says so—but, Anne, it won’t be what I’ve been used to.  <sub>[v3 c14 P13](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0013)</sub>
